texts.orig: In the simplest case where 𝑚 = 0, the map Λ is in fact a Banach space isomorphism between Lip 𝛼 ( 𝐾 ) and CH 0 , 𝛼 ( 𝐾 ) . As a result, we can identify 𝛼 -fractional 0-charges over 𝐾 with 𝛼 -Hölder continuous functions on 𝐾 . In this case, it is known that Lip 𝛼 ( 𝐾 ) is the double dual of the little Hölder space, described for example in [28, Chapter 4]. We treat the general case 𝑚 ⩾ 0 by analogy. We define the space of little 𝛼 -fractional 𝑚 -charges ch 𝑚,𝛼 ( 𝐾 ) as the closure in CH 𝑚,𝛼 ( 𝐾 ) of { Λ ( 𝜔 | 𝐾 ) : 𝜔 smooth } , and we establish that F 𝛼 𝑚 ( 𝐾 ) ch 𝑚,𝛼 ( 𝐾 ) ∗ . Thus any bounded sequence in F 𝛼 𝑚 ( 𝐾 ) possesses a weakly convergent subsequence, by the Banach-Alaoğlu theorem. Convergence in flat norm is later obtained by adapting the classical deformation theorem to the setting of fractional currents.
